fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC Forest Guard/ Wild Life Guard Mains Exam City Details 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the mains exam city details for the recruitment of Forest Guard/ Wild Life Guard posts on the official website of UPSSSC. This recruitment was released for 708 posts. Applications for the UPSSSC Forest Guard/ Wild Life Guard Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 30 June 2026, to 22 July 2026. The examination is going to conducted on 27 September 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this Examination can download their UPSSSC Forest Guard/ Wild Life Guard Mains Exam City Details 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 30 June 2026
  • Last Date : 20 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 July 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 27 July 2026
  • Eligibility Result : 27 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 27 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 18 September 2026
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
